notes.title: THE DEMO IS NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
[b]THE DEMO IS NOW AVAILABLE! - DOWNLOAD IT NOW![/b]

Hello everyone!

At long last, the demo is finally available! The button to download the Demo should be visible to everyone on the main Glyde The Dragon™ page!

You are looking at around 8-10 hours of gameplay in this big demo which acts as a standalone-mini game which will link to the full game!

We have also launched our Kickstarter campaign, if you want to help us realise the full game to it's full potential, please back the campaign!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/valeforgames/glyde-the-dragontm-an-action-adventure-game-about-dragons]CLICK HERE![/url]

Many thanks for your patience and we cannot wait to see your thoughts on the demo! 

Remember that your feedback will help us shape the full game and make sure it's going to be very special!

If you encounter any bugs or issues, please report them on our [url=discord.gg/glyde]OFFICIAL DISCORD[/url] server so we can fix them asap!

Have fun and enjoy Glyding!

- Valefor and the team!
